purpose: Teach: 洗脳/疾病/空想/部族/拷問/国営/改変/公営

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様を洗脳するようなマーケはやめろ
lines.en: Stop with marketing that manipulates customers.
lines.style: Sharp, declarative. Measured pace with weight on the core instruction. Not angry—clinical. The tone of someone stating a non-negotiable principle to someone who should already know it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員向け疾病予防プログラムを実施しております
lines.en: Yes. We're currently implementing an employee wellness and disease prevention program.
lines.style: Respectful, precise. Steady cadence. Brief pause before the specific program title to show he's been listening and responding with concrete action. Slightly formal register—addressing authority.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、空想的な計画ではなく現実的な戦略を立てろ
lines.en: This company needs realistic strategy, not fantasy plans.
lines.style: Steady correction. Slight emphasis on the contrast between 「fantasy」 and 「realistic」. Not lecturing—more like recalibrating the direction. Controlled breathing, no frustration showing through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外の特定部族向け商品を企画しております
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with partnership negotiations with state enterprises.
lines.style: Calm, professional. Measured delivery showing progress being made. No defensiveness—just factual update. Brief, respectful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員を拷問するようなノルマは絶対与えるな
lines.en: Do not—under any circumstances—set quotas that crush your staff.
lines.style: Firm final word. Slight pause after 「not」 for emphasis. Each phrase deliberate. The tone of someone drawing a hard line based on principle, not emotion. Clear-eyed authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。国営企業との提携交渉を進めております
lines.en: Yes. We're planning the product unveiling at the public exhibition venue.
lines.style: Composed closing response. Even pacing, professional register. Signals that the directive has been understood and acted upon. Slight finality in the trailing tone—end of the exchange.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、データの改変は厳禁だ
lines.en: This company has a zero-tolerance policy on data falsification.
lines.style: Absolute, non-negotiable. Crisp opening on 「zero-tolerance」. Steady, unadorned delivery. The voice of someone stating a bedrock principle. No room for interpretation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。公営展示場でのお披露目を計画しております
lines.en: Yes. We have the reveal scheduled for the public exhibition space.
lines.style: Final acknowledgment. Calm, assured. Slightly briefer than the previous update—signals we've moved through the checklist. Professional, settled tone. A small exhale of completion.
